Active evidence freshness

Operational age and the source-defined review cadence; this is not a clinical-validity claim.

No active reference-data release. Locality-based meal evidence will fall back to the governed catalogue.

Four-step publishing workflow

Work from verified provenance to one active release.

0/4 complete
STEP 1

Register a source

Record the official agency, ownership, terms, and update schedule.

STEP 2

Create a release

Give every official file a traceable version before importing it.

STEP 3

Import and reconcile

Load aggregate CSV rows and deliberately resolve unmatched FNRI labels.

STEP 4

Publish an active version

Stage the reviewed release, then publish it for meal-planning evidence.

Register the first source

Who controls what?

Admins govern sources, aggregate survey releases, and FNRI aliases. Nutritionists remain the only role that can clinically approve meals.

Raw FNRI nutrient values stay read-only. Publishing changes which supporting evidence is active; it never rewrites the canonical food composition records.

PLATFORM INTELLIGENCE
Personal enough to matter. Structured enough to trust.

NutriMind connects the everyday user experience with a nutritionist review loop and an administrative verification layer. Each role sees the same nutrition system from the perspective that matters to them.

01
Built around your health context

Goals, allergies, preferences, conditions, and shopping routines shape every planning decision—not just a calorie number.

02
Filipino food intelligence

Meals are grounded in familiar ingredients and Philippine food composition references.

03
Review-aware by design

AI-created meals remain clearly pending until a nutritionist reviews them. Verification is visible, never implied.

04
A library that gets smarter

Verified meals can be reused for compatible profiles, reducing unnecessary generation while growing a trusted collection.

THE INTELLIGENCE LOOP
Designed to learn without hiding the human checkpoint.
01
Profile

Capture health goals, dietary needs, allergies, and lifestyle context.

02
Match

Search compatible verified meals before generating anything new.

03
Generate

Use AI only for plan gaps, with pending status kept visible.

04
Review

Route generated meals to nutritionists and grow the verified library.

FOR REGISTERED NUTRITIONIST-DIETITIANS
Help keep AI-assisted nutrition accountable.

Apply online from anywhere in the Philippines to join NutriMind's professional review team. Every application goes through credential screening and a one-on-one verification call before access is granted.

Apply as a nutritionist
Track an application

STAGE 01

Credential review

PRC license details and professional background are manually assessed.

STAGE 02

One-on-one verification

Choose available schedules, then meet online with a NutriMind administrator.

STAGE 03

Controlled access

Only approved applicants receive a private, expiring account invitation.

OPEN PROJECT JOURNAL
See how the idea became a working capstone.

Explore the problem framing, research direction, architecture decisions, design evolution, and the people-centered thinking behind NutriMind. The documentation space is ready for the team's final story, studies, and project media.
